newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Vienna airport upgraded to "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Vienna airport upgraded to "buy".

text.p: Austria's Creditanstalt Investment Bank (CAIB) said on Monday it had upped Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien to a "buy" from "neutral".
In a report, CAIB said the airport could expect climbing profits thanks to increased passenger numbers and a rationalisation programme.
It forecast earnings per share of 30 schillings this year, rising to 33 schillings next year and 34 schillings in 1999. CAIB had previously forecast EPS of 32 schillings for 1998.
Its short term recommendation for the airport had been "neutral" and its long term "overweight".
CAIB based its recommendation on Vienna airport's position as a gateway to Eastern Europe and its potential for expansion.
It said strong capital resources should enable the airport to fund expansion plans, with an estimated cost of 10 billion schillings, without problems.
